cc:Work.dc:title: All 27 ticks above one second fall near scans.
cc:Work.dc:description: Association, not causation · windows cover 113 / 7,200 ticks (~1.6%); start −1 s through scan end +10 s Exact scan durations inferred from recorded end time and elapsed ms. No matched scan-disabled run; no aggregate latency removed.
